name: frontier-tool
title: Frontier query (the scheduler)
interface: CLI: node tools/frontier.mjs [--dir <project>] [--json]. Prints Open leaf contracts ranked by closability: the number of ancestor contracts that would structurally auto-resolve if this leaf were Done.
nl_description: Replaces task assignment. Any agent picks its next work item from this ranking; no locks, no claims. Closability is a structural upper bound (acceptance gates are assumed green in the hypothetical).
